producer_report.summary:
I added a `bug-evidence` default and a reading step that adds a root-cause-evidence criterion to bug readings. The cause: bug jobs were rejected at the final verdict because no criterion demanded data-backed root-cause evidence. The standing `root-cause` default only asks for a named cause, so readers wrote criteria with no readable-data requirement. The full `cargo test --locked` was not run here. fmt, clippy, the `athena-core`, `athena-data`, `athena-context` tests and the budget, mirror and policy tests all pass.

`defaults.toml` has the new `bug-evidence` default. Its first sentence limits it to bug, wrong-output, regression or slowdown work. Its source cites the four jobs. The `root-cause` default is untouched.

`reading.rs` has `ensure_bug_evidence`, called right after `ensure_changelog` in `build_reading`. For a `change` reading that already has at least one criterion, it adds the content criterion and a `bug-evidence` entry, each once. It refuses nothing. It fires in two cases:
- **Reader listed it:** the reader listed `bug-evidence` and its `how` doesn't say it does not apply.
- **Request names bug work:** a bug word sits within two words of a fix word in the request, in the retried job's request, or in the reading's title.

`read_once` now passes the request and the earlier request to `build_reading`.

The new default's line took the reader prompt from 1997 to 2036 tokens, over its 2000 budget. I raised `BudgetSet::Reader` to 2050 and appended decision D166, which states this is a decided exception to the no-raise rule. The reader stays at 99.3%, so the next reader addition must name what it removes. The pin test in `run_pin_tests.rs` now reads the budget instead of the literal 2000. I also updated `docs/system-facts.md` and `docs/design/context-engineer.md`.

The reading listed `athena.toml` as a deliverable, but it holds no reader token budget, so it is unchanged. `CHANGELOG.md` and a new section 3.9 in `docs/design/defaults-loop.md` record the cause, both triggers and their limits.

checks_run.note: Before the budget raise the reader set measured 2036 of 2000 and 4 budget tests failed. After the raise to 2050 all 5 budget tests and all 4 mirror tests pass.
1184 passed, 1 ignored, 0 failed in the lib target; the other targets (including refusal_corpus) pass
Applied formatting; fmt --check was not run separately after it
17 pass; the boundary scan finds no banned word in tracked files

criteria_check.criterion: defaults.toml has a new [[default]] with id bug-evidence for bug, wrong-output and regression requests. Its statement requires that the change names the root cause, shows it from data the job can read (records, code path, a failing case), and shows why the wrong output or metric change follows, before any fix. It says a guess labelled as an estimate does not meet it. Its source cites 20261104-054700-e6js, 20261105-051344-q9fv, 20261105-101121-qw9r and 20261105-205835-hk09. The existing root-cause default is not reworded.
criteria_check.evidence: Read defaults.toml: the new bug-evidence entry (applies_to *) follows behavior-evidence. Its statement opens 'Only for bug, wrong-output, regression or slowdown work: name the root cause from readable data.' and goes on with before any fix, data the job can read (records, a code path or a failing case), why the symptom follows, and 'a guess labelled as an estimate does not meet this'. Its source cites all four job ids. cargo test -p athena-data bug_evidence passes; it asserts these phrases and the four ids, and that the root-cause statement equals its base text byte for byte.

criteria_check.criterion: crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs has a step called next to ensure_changelog in build_reading that adds the root-cause-evidence criterion and a bug-evidence defaults_applied entry exactly once for bug, wrong-output, regression and slowdown readings, and nothing for other readings. A Grep for bug-evidence in that file shows it.
criteria_check.evidence: ensure_bug_evidence(&mut reading, request_texts) is called right after ensure_changelog(&mut reading) and before reading.validate() in build_reading. BUG_EVIDENCE_ID = "bug-evidence" and the default's how text are in reading.rs. cargo test -p athena-core --lib bug_evidence_step_is_called_beside_ensure_changelog passes and pins the order. It adds nothing for study and declined readings or for non-bug requests; the keywords test pins that.

criteria_check.criterion: Unit tests in crates/athena-core/src/reading.rs build a reading from a bug request and assert the criterion and defaults entry are present. They assert a non-bug reading gets neither, and that running the step twice adds them once. Run `cargo test -p athena-core`.
criteria_check.evidence: cargo test -p athena-core --lib bug_evidence runs 13 tests, all pass. bug_evidence_reading_gains_criterion_and_default builds a reading through the real build_reading from a bug request and asserts one criterion and one entry. bug_evidence_keywords_and_non_bug_readings has a positive and a negative table, plus study and declined readings. bug_evidence_step_is_idempotent runs the step twice. Full cargo test -p athena-core --quiet: 1184 passed, 0 failed.

criteria_check.criterion: A test in crates/athena-data/src/defaults.rs asserts bug-evidence parses from the repo defaults.toml and its first-sentence line renders. Run `cargo test -p athena-data`.
criteria_check.evidence: bug_evidence_default_parses_and_renders_its_first_sentence parses REPO_DEFAULTS and asserts the rendered line '- bug-evidence [*]: <first sentence>\n'. It also asserts the later sentences are absent from the render. cargo test -p athena-data: 187 passed.

criteria_check.criterion: `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --workspace` and `cargo test --workspace` pass. Existing tests keep their outcomes and the prompt token budget tests pass.
criteria_check.evidence: left to Athena's checks for the workspace-wide fmt, clippy and test runs. Run here: cargo fmt --all applied; cargo clippy --all-targets --locked -- -D warnings clean; cargo test -p athena-core, -p athena-data, -p athena-context, and -p athena-cli --test budgets --test mirrors, and xtask policy, all pass. I did not run the full cargo test --locked.

criteria_check.criterion: Governance: defaults.toml is changed and named here. athena.toml changes only if the reader prompt budget check requires it, and then only that budget value. CHANGELOG.md has an entry that names the cause: bug jobs were rejected at the final verdict because no criterion demanded data-backed root-cause evidence. docs/design/defaults-loop.md mentions the new default.
criteria_check.evidence: athena.toml is unchanged: the reader token budget is BudgetSet::Reader in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, not an athena.toml key, so that file was edited (2,000 to 2,050) and D166 records it. The CHANGELOG.md Unreleased item states the cause in those words. defaults-loop.md has a new section 3.9 on bug-evidence. cargo test -p athena-core --lib bug_evidence_changelog_and_design_doc_name_the_cause passes. git diff --stat shows no athena.toml and no records/ path.

criteria_check.criterion: Standing defaults hold. outcome-check: a newcomer reading the new default and the criterion text can tell what evidence is required. root-cause: the change description states why bug jobs were rejected. tested: new tests pass. no-empty-success and thrash-stop apply unchanged. records/ is untouched.
criteria_check.evidence: bug_evidence_criterion_and_default_state_the_same_evidence passes: the default statement and ROOT_CAUSE_EVIDENCE_CRITERION both contain 'root cause', 'data the job can read', 'before any fix' and 'a guess labelled as an estimate does not meet this'. The CHANGELOG.md item, D166 and section 3.9 state the rejection cause. The new tests pass. git status lists no records/ path.

open_issues: Departure from the reading: athena.toml is unchanged. The reader budget lives in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, so that file, run_pin_tests.rs, docs/system-facts.md, docs/decisions.md (appended D166) and docs/design/context-engineer.md changed too, each forced by a test or rule.
The raise to 2,050 leaves the reader at 99.3%, above the 95% rule in context-engineer.md section 8. D166 states this as a decided exception; the next reader addition must name what it removes.

Limits of tier 2 (documented in the doc comment, section 3.9 and the CHANGELOG): a request like 'fix the crash' has no listed bug word, and a retry of a retry carries no bug word, so only the reader's listing of the default (tier 1) and the title cover them.
The negation backstop matches only the listed phrases and the token n/a. Other wordings of 'does not apply' are trusted as a listing.
docs/decisions.md still contains the older '1997 of 2000' mentions in D-entries older than D166. They are history and the log is append-only, so I left them.
mistakes: The first draft of the default put 'Before any fix' at the start of a sentence, so the case-sensitive test phrase failed; I made the test compare in lowercase.
I ran cargo fmt --all but not fmt --check afterwards; the tree was formatted by the command itself.
learnings: The reader token budget is BudgetSet::Reader in crates/athena-context/src/lib.rs, not an athena.toml key.
The new default's first sentence took the reader set from 1997 to 2036 tokens (measured by cargo test -p athena-cli --test budgets). The budget is now 2050, so the reader is at 99.3%.
run_pin_tests.rs pinned the literal 'of 2000'; it now reads BudgetSet::Reader.budget().
docs/decisions.md is append-only; D166 is appended after D165 and D25 is not edited.

Root cause of the rejections: bug jobs were rejected at the final verdict because no criterion demanded data-backed root-cause evidence. The standing root-cause default only asks for a named cause, so readers wrote criteria with no readable-data requirement.
The old docs/system-facts.md text says 'update the line, never the budget'. D166 and context-engineer.md section 8 record this raise as the decided exception.
desires: A way to run the whole workspace test suite and read its failures without piping, since the saved output of a long run was outside the readable directory.
